subject: Supplier account sync — invoice SLA, PO visibility & EU VAT routing
messages:
From: Lucía Martín <lucia.martin@sonderpay.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: ap-team@sonderpay.com
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 14:12:00 +0100
Subject: Onboarding Redwood as a vendor / PO visibility + VAT handling

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We need to get Redwood set up in our supplier master so our AP systems can route POs and pay on our 30-day SLA. A couple of asks to finish the admin intake: 

- Can you confirm the exact remit-to address and bank details we should use on invoices?
- Do you have a VAT registration number for EU invoicing (we need an EU VAT id for reverse-charge where applicable)?
- Our system requires a single canonical "Customer PO" field mapping (we call it CUSTOMER_REF) — can Redwood include that field on every invoice?
- We will request vendor registration via our portal (vendor-portal@acme-retail.com) and will need a contact for KYC follow-ups.

I attached the SonderPay AP intake form for your reference (we'll push an invite to your vendor email). Please send the packet plus a sample invoice. If you prefer, we can accept the onboarding packet and signed tax form via DocuSign.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we have a go-live on April 4 and need vendor records in place by March 29.

Best,
Lucía Martín
Senior AP Manager, SonderPay
lucia.martin@sonderpay.com
+44 20 7123 4567

<Attachment: sonderpay_vendor_intake_form.pdf>

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Lucía Martín <lucia.martin@sonderpay.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 16:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Onboarding Redwood as a vendor / PO visibility + VAT handling

Thanks Lucía — looping in Jordan (billing) and Marcus (payments) to confirm details below. Per your asks: 

- Remit-to / banking: Redwood invoices should be remitted via bank transfer to: Redwood Inference Ltd. / Sort: 20-11-22 / Account: 12345678 / IBAN: GB29NWBK60161331926819 / BIC: NWBKGB2L. Please use the remit-to name exactly as above to avoid routing delays.
- VAT: Redwood has an EU VAT registration for our London entity: GB999999973. For reverse-charge queries, include our VAT on the invoice header and, when the PO indicates reverse-charge, mark line: "VAT reverse-charge — customer liable."
- CUSTOMER_REF mapping: we will include CUSTOMER_REF and PO_NUMBER fields in the invoice metadata and in the CSV sample. Please confirm which field you will map to your CUSTOMER_REF (PO number or internal project code).
- Portal: our vendor contact for KYC: vendor-ops@redwood.ai (primary) and finance@redwood.ai (fallback).

I've attached our AP onboarding packet (PDF) and a sample CSV invoice exported from our billing system. Jordan / Marcus — quick questions: can we accept payment currency EUR for SonderPay and consolidate remittance weekly? Also, Jordan, please confirm that every invoice will include the CUSTOMER_REF and that the CSV uses ISO date and EUR 2-decimal formatting.

Next step: Lucía — once you have the portal invite, we can upload the signed tax form (we'll attach the EU equivalent of W9) and confirm the vendor code you assign so we can populate our PO references.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
<Attachment: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_SonderPay.pdf>

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding Redwood as a vendor / PO visibility + VAT handling

On Wed, 20 Mar 2028 at 16:03, kimberly_park@redwood.ai wrote:
> I've attached our AP onboarding packet (PDF) and a sample CSV invoice exported from our billing system.

Quick confirmation from billing side:
- We will send invoices in EUR for SonderPay. Our standard terms for this partner will remain Net 30. We can opt into weekly remittance consolidation if SonderPay supports a single weekly payment (helps reduce wire costs).
- CUSTOMER_REF: we'll populate CUSTOMER_REF with the customer PO number when provided; if SonderPay sends a different internal code, we will include PO_NUMBER and CUSTOMER_REF as separate metadata fields. Recommend they map CUSTOMER_REF to PO_NUMBER to avoid duplicate mapping.
- Invoice format: sample attached (Sample_Invoice_REDWOOD_20280301.csv). CSV includes columns: INVOICE_NUM, INVOICE_DATE (YYYY-MM-DD), PO_NUMBER, CUSTOMER_REF, DESCRIPTION, NET_AMOUNT, VAT_AMOUNT, TOTAL, CURRENCY, REMIT_INSTRUCTIONS.

Marcus — on bank remittance: are there any restrictions on the IBAN above for EUR settlement? If they want EUR credit to our GBP account, we should provide an EUR account instead to avoid conversion fees.

Jordan Blake
Billing Lead
Redwood Inference
<Attachment: Sample_Invoice_REDWOOD_20280301.csv>
